summary: Complete evidence-bounded static redesign for Anarco Restaurante. Built index.html (production homepage with typographic hero on bordô, asymmetric dish editorial spread, two-column unit bifurcation with contextual WhatsApp CTAs), styles.css (committed color strategy, Playfair Display + Open Sans disciplined pairing, fluid clamp typography, mobile-first responsive), script.js (mobile nav toggle, smooth scroll, intersection observer reveals), proposal.html (independent sales document), rationale.html (redirect to proposal), README.md, SITE_REVIEW.md, SOURCE_MANIFEST.md. Three art-directed moments: typographic hero invitation, asymmetric dish spread, contextual unit bifurcation. No generic patterns, no card grids, no cream body bg, no gradient text, no glassmorphism. All business facts sourced from prospect.json evidence.
